## Functions

### `createRealmRuntimeAttemptBinding(...args)`

Construct one trusted host's explicit, process-local attempt rendezvous. There are no options, registry globals, dependencies, storage, subscriptions, controllers, operator values, or generation allocations in this primitive. Only `binding` enters a version-2 composition lease/mount context. Its single synchronous bindAttempt accepts the exact frozen native signal triple created by Entry. It snapshots those roots before inspection; it neither starts nor authorizes a session. Identical live repeats are idempotent. Replacement waits for the old teardown root to abort, then requires three never-before-bound roots. Weak membership prevents reuse without retaining historical roots. The host privately retains captureAttempt({ signal }) and close(). Capture requires the exact bound construction root and all roots still live. A future genuine lifecycle allocation calls it at the existing allocation step, after inspection/operator snapshot, and independently authenticates the operator, reserves a new durable generation, and fences construction as well as work and teardown. A binding receipt alone is never issuance or currentness proof. close() is synchronous and idempotent, but refuses an attempt whose teardown root remains live. It never aborts a root to manufacture cleanup success. Its receipt proves only rendezvous closure, not resource/owner/pin release, retirement, isolated execution, or full lifecycle/provider acceptance.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
